NewsGram
Pick the highlights. Frame the story.
Checking saved session…

1. Set up your capture

Capture a webpage, or upload an image or PDF. Then pick and frame highlights below.

Webpage appearance · Adjust540px · Article only · Photos stacked

These settings affect the webpage screenshot—not your Instagram image dimensions. They don’t change an uploaded image or PDF.

Instagram image shape
1080 × 1350px · applies to all highlights

Change the shape anytime. It applies to every highlight without recapturing the webpage.

Webpage settings changed. Capture again to apply them; your current highlights are unchanged until you confirm replacing them.

or

Images: PNG, JPEG or WebP. PDFs: up to 50 MB and 20 pages, processed on this device.

Capture an article or upload an image or PDF, then choose only the highlights you want to post.
2. Pick & frame your highlights
YOUR CAROUSEL
No capture yet
Original ↗
4:5 PORTRAIT FRAME

HighlightsDrag the ⠿ handles to reorder
Your chosen highlights will appear here.
▣
One highlight at a time.
Capture or upload a file, then frame it here.
Highlight 1
Cut mode · Drag a band across the screenshot, then adjust its edges.
Edge detail · 2×
Remove this section

Only this highlight changes. Content below moves up; empty space at the end stays white. Escape cancels.

0px
100%

Drag or scroll to move · pinch or use the slider to zoom · ✂ Cut removes unwanted sections

Sections removed from this highlight

The original capture is untouched. Adjust reopens a cut’s original content without committing changes; Restore brings it back.

Check that the excerpt still conveys the original meaning. The divider makes omissions visible.

Export highlight

Preparing your PNG…

Sharing opens the system share sheet, not an automatic Instagram post. Filenames are numbered; check image order in your posting app. Some destinations may not accept multiple images.

Import PDF

Processed on this device. Pages keep their layout and become one scrollable image.

Pages to join

Up to 20 pages and 50 MB. Long documents are rendered at a smaller width to protect memory; import fewer pages for sharper text. Interactive elements become pixels.
Captures use Microlink (free-tier limits apply). Sessions and uploads stay in this browser; PDFs render locally.
PDF engine & third-party licenses
PDF.js 5.4.624 and bundled font, CMap and image-decoder assets.
Distribution JavaScript is bundled to classic ES2020 IIFEs with esbuild for loader compatibility.
No PDF rendering logic is intentionally changed; application integration is NewsGram code.
